uv_convention: UV0 of the wool = pattern metres / tile_m (1 UV unit = one 0.45 m tile) -> UV Scale 1.0. Pattern pieces authored in plain metres: UV Scale = 2.2222. Tiling UVs may overlap (garment_unique_uvs stays False).

T_BlackCloakV2_Cloth_ORM.channels: R cavity AO (gentle, mean 0.97), G roughness (0.78-0.93, mean 0.86), B metal 0

T_BlackCloakV2_Cloth_Detail16.note: pack recolour convention (MATERIAL_PLAN 5.1): BaseColor = Colour x (Bias + Scale x Detail); constants in T_BlackCloakV2_maps.json -> detail16

T_BlackCloakV2_Fray_BCA.note: turn on mip alpha-coverage preservation (thin fibres vanish at distance otherwise); tiles along U, row 0 = cloth side

unreal.base_color: T_BC x Tint (Tint default 1,1,1)  - or through the pack's MF_TintDetail with T_Detail16 and the detail16 constants for recolouring
unreal.normal: T_N (DirectX, no green flip), Normal Strength 1.0
unreal.mapping_note: Blender sheen weight w, tint t -> Unreal Fuzz Colour = t x w, Cloth = w: the pack's measured Blender->Unreal sheen mapping (WorkFiles/materials/MATERIALS_REPORT.md 4.5, RMS log error 0.259). Blender Specular IOR Level L and Unreal Specular S both mean F0 = 0.08 x value, so S = L = 0.1.
unreal.open_check: NOT verified in Unreal (only the Unreal agent may launch it). The pack found Unreal's Cloth lobe REPLACES the GGX specular and dims the grazing rim (kunai wrap: Default Lit measured closer, 0.206 vs 0.259). Before shipping, run the pack's sheen sphere calibration (Scripts/unreal/materials/verify/sheen_compare.py method) for this albedo; fallback = Default Lit, Specular 0.15, no fuzz.
